workarounds.symptom: `uvx` "Failed to spawn" on CPython dev builds with `+dev` version suffix
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix `uvx` on CPython builds with local versions. Target files: crates/uv-python-interpreter/src/environment.rs, crates/uv-python-interpreter/src/virtualenv.rs, crates/uv/tests/pip_install/pip_install.rs. With a CPython development build, `uvx` installs the tool successfully, then fails to launch it: We write `3.16.0a1+dev` to `pyvenv.cfg`, but the reader rejects the local version and discards the rest of the file. The installed entry point then refers to the temporary interpreter path, which disappears when we move the environ... (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23013)

workarounds.symptom: `uv audit` reports duplicate advisory with wrong fix version
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Deduplicate aliased OSV findings in uv audit. Target files: crates/uv-audit-operations/src/lib.rs, crates/uv-audit/src/service/osv.rs, crates/uv-audit/src/types.rs. For each dependency, keep a list of advisory groups. Merge every group whose IDs overlap the incoming record, so a third record can join two previously separate groups. Grouping runs per package and version before ignore rules, counts and output formatting. All IDs in the group remain available for display and suppression. Both ignore lists record every matching ID... (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22990)

workarounds.symptom: Windows trampoline can close its own child or job handle when started through the C runtime's spawn, so the child is lost
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Stop closing handles listed in `lpReserved2` in the Windows trampoline. Target files: crates/uv-trampoline/src/bounce.rs, crates/uv-trampoline-builder/trampolines/uv-trampoline-aarch64-console.exe, crates/uv-trampoline-builder/trampolines/uv-trampoline-aarch64-gui.exe. Windows has a concept of handle inheritance, despite not having all the other features that make sense to have if you have that, such as exec, and this means that our trampolines must stick around while the interpreter runs. This means that we end up with a copy... (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22977)

Fix: Use AMD64 for x86-64 Windows platform markers. Target files: crates/uv-configuration/src/target_triple.rs, crates/uv/tests/pip_install/pip_install.rs. CPython reports `platform.machine()` as `AMD64` on x86-64 Windows. We now use that value for `--python-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` and its `windows` alias. Previously, both used `x86_64`, so uv skipped dependencies guarded by `platform_machine == 'AMD64'` and rejected `pylock.toml` files that used the same marker in `environments`. (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22935)

workarounds.symptom: `uv run --active --script` deletes the contents of a non-virtual-environment `VIRTUAL_ENV`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Protect non-virtualenv directories with --active --script. Target files: crates/uv-environment-operations/src/error.rs, crates/uv-environment-operations/src/lib.rs, crates/uv/tests/project/run.rs. `uv run --active --script` and `uv sync --active --script` can delete a nonempty `VIRTUAL_ENV` directory when it cannot be reused, even if it is not a virtual environment. (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21464)

workarounds.symptom: Panic (`OperatorLocalCombo`) when `python_full_version not in '<version>+local'` is combined with an upper bound
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Reproduce local-version marker rendering panic. Target files: crates/uv-pep508/src/marker/tree.rs. A `python_full_version not in '3.20+x'` marker combined with an upper bound panics when rendered. Add a focused `MarkerTree` reproducer for astral-sh/uv#22804. (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22807)

workarounds.symptom: packages with android wheels but no sdist fail to resolve
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Infer platform markers from Android wheel tags. Target files: crates/uv-platform-tags/src/tags.rs, crates/uv-resolver/src/prioritized_distribution.rs, crates/uv/tests/lock/lock.rs. `implied_platform_markers()` in resolution does not cover any Android wheels, causing an error when trying to lock a package that has no sdist but does have Android wheels. See #22805 for a more in-depth explainer of the issue. This PR fixes this by adding the `PlatformTag::Android` match arm to `implied_platform_markers()`, emitting the implicit pl... (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22806)
